title: Butterfly with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='wingGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff7bd5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb347'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wingGrad2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7be0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c07bff'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- upper wings -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='38' rx='22' ry='17' fill='url(#wingGrad)' transform='rotate(-20 30 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='38' rx='22' ry='17' fill='url(#wingGrad)' transform='rotate(20 70 38)'/>
  <!-- wing spots -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='34' r='6' fill='#ffe066' transform='rotate(-20 26 34)'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='34' r='6' fill='#ffe066' transform='rotate(20 74 34)'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#7be0ff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#7be0ff'/>
  <!-- lower wings -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='62' rx='15' ry='12' fill='url(#wingGrad2)' transform='rotate(15 33 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='62' rx='15' ry='12' fill='url(#wingGrad2)' transform='rotate(-15 67 62)'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='61' r='4.5' fill='#ff7bd5'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='61' r='4.5' fill='#ff7bd5'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='5' ry='22' fill='#6ee7a8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='2' ry='18' fill='#a8ffe0'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M48 32 Q42 20 38 16' stroke='#ffd66e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 32 Q58 20 62 16' stroke='#ffd66e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='16' r='3' fill='#ff9be0'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='16' r='3' fill='#ff9be0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='7' fill='#6ee7a8'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='33' r='3.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='33' r='3.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='33' r='1.8' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='33' r='1.8' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='47.8' cy='32.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='53.8' cy='32.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- sparkles around eyes -->
  <path d='M44 28 l1.2 2.2 l-2.2 0 z' fill='#ffd66e'/>
  <path d='M56 28 l1.2 2.2 l-2.2 0 z' fill='#ffd66e'/>
  <path d='M43 38 l1 1.8 l-1.8 0 z' fill='#ffd66e'/>
  <path d='M57 38 l1 1.8 l-1.8 0 z' fill='#ffd66e'/>
</svg>
